The Last Transmission
The dish has caught pieces of an 18-year-old message from PROJECT HORIZON, an expedition that vanished while studying the dark mass.

Radio astronomy pulls weak signals out of noise: narrow the bandwidth and integrate longer, and the signal-to-noise ratio grows as √t. Mass bends light by an angle that grows with mass, which lets lensing and trajectories weigh the same object.
You rebuilt Horizon's timeline, found its relay and decoded its archive with a key only a physicist would compute. The object is six Earth masses squeezed into a few centimetres. That is no planet.

Event Horizon
With Horizon's data, Dr. Chen wants to reproduce the object in the new Black Hole Research Laboratory and find the source of its strange signal.

For a black hole, r_s = 2GM/c². Light passing at distance b bends by 4GM/(c²b). Gas orbiting at the innermost stable orbit circles at a frequency set by mass and spin, so the frequency measures the spin.

HORIZON-1 is a primordial black hole: six Earth masses, a horizon the size of a grapefruit, spinning at 80% of the maximum. It has drifted at the edge of the Solar System since the first second of the universe.

What Mars Breathes

Orbits That Wander
In the black-hole lab, launch an orbit that is not quite circular and watch how relativity differs from Newton.

Water purification sequence
Raw ice from the plain carries dust, salts and toxic perchlorates. Put the treatment steps in the right order.
Melt the ice in the heated tank
Let sediment settle and filter out the regolith
Distil the water to remove salts and perchlorates
Oxidise remaining organics with a catalyst
Polish with ion exchange, add minerals and store
Correct. Coarse to fine: physical removal first, then distillation for dissolved salts, then chemical polishing. The water is now cleaner than most tap water on Earth.
